name: shapr-film
description: Shapr product film: deterministic HTML/SVG scenes rendered frame by frame in headless Chromium, encoded with FFmpeg.

scripts.proxy:hero: node scripts/render.mjs film --film hero --proxy && node scripts/assemble.mjs --film hero --proxy
scripts.audio: python3 scripts/audio/narration.py && for f in hero trailer tour; do python3 scripts/audio/score.py --film $f; done
scripts.captions: node scripts/captions.mjs --film hero --out exports/shapr_hero && node scripts/captions.mjs --film trailer --out exports/shapr_trailer_60s && node scripts/captions.mjs --film tour --out exports/shapr_feature_tour
scripts.validate: for f in exports/*.mp4; do python3 scripts/validate.py $f; done
